bug_info.bug_desc: In the Phase3 state, when the counter reaches the configured phase cycle count, the FSM sets state_d to Terminal and cnt_clr to 1, but leaves cnt_en at its default asserted value for that state. The counter register update logic prioritizes (cnt_en && cnt_clr) as a load of 1, so on the clock edge entering Terminal the count is set to 1 instead of being cleared to 0. This violates the specification that entering Terminal clears the count and that Terminal's count output is zero; the output shows an extra count of 1 for one cycle in Terminal.
bug_info.fix_hint: When Phase3 completes and state_d is Terminal, force cnt_en to 0 so that only cnt_clr is active on the transition into Terminal. This makes the counter register take the cnt_clr path and clear cnt_q to 0 on the same edge that enters Terminal, matching the spec.
